newsitem.title: DUBAI: BankWatch rates Bank of Bahrain and Kuwait.
newsitem.headline: BankWatch rates Bank of Bahrain and Kuwait.

text.p: U.S. rating agency Thomson BankWatch said on Tuesday it assigned ratings to Bahrain-based Bank of Bahrain and Kuwait.
BankWatch said it assigned the Manama-based bank an intra-country issuer rating of IC-C and a short-term local currency debt rating of LC-1.
"Bank of Bahrain and Kuwait is in the midst of organisational changes aimed at improving the financial institution," a BankWatch statement faxed to Reuters said.
"While profitability has been quite good for many consecutive years, management envisions better efficiency and coordination throughout the bank," it said.
"The bank maintains ample capital and loan loss reserves to suport the balance sheet containing somewhat more risk than that of many local peers in the region," it added.
